item.title: Game Night
item.description: Last night was my weekly night to play games with my friend Vinny. I have been playing Enemy Territory every Wednesday night since last Summer with a few cancellations here and there. Earlier this year Vinny convinced me to try World of Warcraft, a very addictive online multiplayer game. I was hooked from the start but not being able to “dedicate” to more than a couple of hours a week I eventually lost interest. I guess a big factor for my lack of interest was the fact that the people I knew online just kept racking up levels and moved on to different realms and tougher quests, while I was still stuck at level 4!
